Additionally, among the bug reports we have received, Steam Cloud errors account for a significant portion. Due to the high degree of freedom in object placement, the game may generate many save files with a relatively large total size. This may make it more likely to trigger synchronization errors when uncontrollable factors like network fluctuations occur. Although we are trying our best to optimize the save logic and reduce the error rate, we cannot guarantee a complete fix.
Because of this, we recommend avoiding using the Steam Cloud feature unless necessary to ensure save data safety.

We apologize for the inconvenience. If these errors cannot be effectively reduced, we plan to disable the Steam Cloud feature by default in the mid-February update. We truly appreciate your understanding.

releases.displayName: 150K Copies Sold! Thank You, and Here's the December Update Plan!

items.text: Dear Town Builders,
As soon as the morning light coated the town robot's metallic contours in the first touch of warmth, it
began gathering every story you brought.
We stil remember the first time we saw the room designs you shared our whole team gathered around
the computer, grinning from ear to ear. Some of you turned your litle houses into cat cafés, while others
transformed living rooms into stages. At that moment, we truly felt that the town exists because of you.
Now, three months have passed, and the town has welcomed 150,000 builders! Thank you all for
your love and support.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/e2c0797d7963e72ddf48e4bf17453be4d2177607.png"]
Moving forward, we will continue to fix bugs and optimize the game. Beyond the usual fixes, brand-new
content is in the works, some lively little characters are eager to meet you in December!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/bfe3c650388c07827f0f690c20a48c053457b2ab.png"]
Meanwhile, localization is also speeding up, with Korean and Spanish versions in production. We hope
friends from around the world can come to the town for a cup of coffee or a little furniture arrangement.
In the future, besides more stories and furniture, we plan to explore Mod support, allowing everyone to
visit each other's homes, create their own furniture, and share their creative designs.
The town could never have grown without your company. Our team is small-fewer than ten people-so
updates may take some time, but every step we take is made with care and dedication.

Additionally, the Steam Annual Awards nominations have begun! If our town has ever made you linger and forget to leave, please nominate Whisper of the House! Every single vote from you is truly meaningful. ♥
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/5a9aedb9b73516adde20f3f2dba85ca4fcc5ff1c.png"]
Once again, thank you to every single town builder. Your shared room designs and words of
encouragement bring the town to life and give us the motivation to keep moving forward.
If tonight you light a lamp in the town, perhaps we are all under the same gentle glow. ☆
With love, GD Studio team

releases.displayName: Progress Report (Sept 1 – Sept 5) & Delay of House Purchase Feature

items.text: Dear Star Housekeepers,
[p align="start"]Over the past week, our updates have mainly focused on:
Fixing certain quest flows that could get stuck
Correcting object sizes and properties that caused issues
Improving parts of the UI display and localization
Optimizing certain operations and prompts
Replaced problematic and questionable assets

[p align="start"]However, we’re sorry to say that the workload has exceeded our expectations. The house purchase feature, which was originally scheduled to be completed this week, is not ready yet and will be delayed. We hope to bring it to you as soon as possible!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/bbadcac5965a85d563ec1ae5c9a9f5069dd6a302.png"](Work-in-progress UI preview)

[p align="start"]In the meantime, we’ve received over 70 replies in our feedback thread this past week—thank you so much! Your comments made us realize there’s still room to refine the details of the current version. Therefore, for this month, our updates will mainly focus on:
Better quest guidance
Furniture search & categorization
Completing furniture sets
[p align="start"]Thank you again for your patience and understanding. We’re excited to keep improving the game with your support!

releases.displayName: Hospital Towel Fix and Apology for Missing Voucher

items.text: We would like to sincerely thank you for playing our game right after launch.

A patch has just been released to address the issue where hospital towels could not be properly stored. To ensure a smooth experience, please exit the game, apply the update, and then re-enter. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Regarding the matter of some players being unable to receive the 2000 vouchers after playing the demo, we are actively seeking a solution. However, due to Steam’s library system, it may not be possible to fulfill this exactly as originally planned. We will do our utmost to provide alternative compensation, and kindly ask for your understanding.

In the current version, the vouchers earned through gameplay progression should be sufficient to cover furniture collection, so you may continue to enjoy the game without concern. We will share further updates with you as soon as new progress is made.

releases.displayName: Apology and Replacement of Inappropriate Content with a New Room

items.text: Dear all,

We sincerely apologize for the inappropriate content and the absence of necessary content warnings. Upon reflection, we realize we failed to anticipate how distressing some elements could be, which was a significant oversight on our part.
The inappropriate content has already been removed and replaced with a new room in this update.
It was never our intention to cause harm, and we deeply regret any distress this may have caused. We appreciate your valuable feedback and will continue to do our best to improve.
Sincerely,
GD Studio
